$comment: Lists the MCP server names bundled with Konductor's Claude Code outputs (read by scripts/read-bundled-mcp-servers.sh into the --claude-bundled-mcp-servers allowlist). Only aws-mcp is bundled; other MCP servers are user-configured. Each agent spec under agents/*.agent-spec.json declares its own bundled server's launch command/args directly in dependencies.mcpRegistry -- that is the single source of truth for the pinned command, not this file, so no definition is duplicated here.

byo.$comment: This section is documentation only. Entries here are not generated into plugin or standalone MCP configuration.
